caption: The drawing contains three depictions of a circular object, positioned centrally within a larger rectangular border on a cream-colored background. The first depiction, in the upper left quadrant, is a top view of a round object with a black central area bordered by a gold ring featuring a fine patterned edge. In the middle of the black area is a white star-like design encircling a central round blue area containing a smaller yellow circle. Below and slightly to the right, the second depiction shows the same round object from the back; it is primarily black with a gold rim, and includes a visible hinge or pin component that extends vertically in the center, suggesting a functional element such as a clasp or bar. To the right and between the two circular views is a side profile of the object, which appears as a thin, rectangular mechanism bordered with gold, showing a hint of the black face and the central blue detail from its top view, and a pin-like structure extending horizontally. The artist’s signature “W.W. Jennings” appears in the bottom right corner inside the rectangular border. The composition is sparse, with the objects occupying the central part of the drawing, and ample blank space on all sides.
title: Brooch
